title: Diffusion MRI: MRtrix3 and FSL single-subject workflow
description: Audited single-subject diffusion MRI workflow combining MRtrix3 and FSL for preprocessing, diffusion tensor metrics, constrained spherical deconvolution, tractography, SIFT filtering, quantitative summaries, and visual quality control.
notes: Audited portfolio release. Public quantitative results, tensor-validity sensitivity checks, SIFT termination behaviour, processing provenance, scripts, and primary QC figures were reviewed. The completed SIFT output contains 189356 streamlines despite a requested 100000 target. The acquisition lacks reverse phase-encoding data, so TOPUP susceptibility correction was not possible. Results are descriptive single-subject outputs and tractography is not interpreted as direct anatomical connectivity.
